summary: Iteration 7 — Central de Mídia Externa (embed-only, YouTube/Vimeo). Added 11 new backend tests across 2 classes (TestMediaParse, TestExternalMediaCRUDAndAccess) — all 11 pass. Full suite: 74 passed / 1 skipped by design / 2 pre-existing flaky (see below). Playwright (mobile 390x844) validated 16 UI checkpoints: (a) formador logs in, opens /app/midia (MediaCenter with tabs media-tab-all/video/live/favorites/history + media-search) and reaches /app/midia/gerenciar via media-manage-btn; (b) POST /media/parse via media-parse-btn — invalid URL toasts error, valid YouTube (watch?v=) shows media-preview '✓ YouTube · ID … · incorporável: sim'; (c) creates a stage-1 VIDEO and a stage-3 LIVE (kind-video/kind-live toggle, media-title, media-stage-1/3, media-live-status appears only for kind=live, media-submit); (d) live-status-{id} dropdown changes status to 'live' successfully; (e) formador does NOT see 'Provedores' section — hidden correctly; (f) MediaCenter tabs & search work; (g) prevoc (etapa 1) does NOT see media-manage-btn, opens the stage-1 media card and gets media-player + media-iframe (YouTube embed) + media-open-platform-link + can toggle media-favorite-btn; (h) membro (etapa 3) does NOT see the stage-1 media in the list — stage invariant respected; (i) mestre sees provider-toggle-youtube and provider-toggle-vimeo checkboxes. Test-created data cleaned via UI + curl after tests.

minor.issue: Endpoint capped at 50 items with no pagination; TestLivesLifecycle::test_start_and_end_live is now flaky because the total notification volume produced by the enlarged test suite exceeds the cap, so 'len(notes) > n_before' cannot distinguish the newly-created 🔴 Ao vivo notification. Pre-existing (iteration 6 passed) — surfaced by additional media notifications. Recommend paginating (skip/limit) or filtering by created_at.

TestConclusionDoesNotPromote::test_formation_status_concluded_but_stage_unchanged intermittently observes concluded=false (7/8 lessons, 88%). Data drift from other tests toggling membro state in parallel workers; not a regression from media feature.

action_items: Consider paginating GET /api/notifications (limit/skip) so tests can reliably detect new notifications; OR expose a since=<iso> filter.
Nice-to-have: audit trail entry for POST /external-media/{id}/favorite (currently no audit() call, unlike other media endpoints).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1700 lines; the Central de Mídia section is self-contained (~300 lines) and is a clean candidate to split into backend/routers/media.py alongside the earlier recommendation.

media_accessible() grants full access to admins & formadores regardless of stages. Confirm this is intended for admin — the invariant is 'apenas Mestre altera etapas', not 'apenas Mestre vê tudo'; if content is truly stage-scoped, admin viewing stage-restricted mídia may leak preview material.

POST /external-media/{id}/favorite calls media_accessible before toggle: this means a member CANNOT un-favorite a media that later becomes restricted to another stage (they'd get 403). Consider allowing DELETE-favorite regardless of current access.

set_media_live_status iterates `async for mm in db.users.find(q)` and awaits notify() per member — same pattern flagged in iteration 6 for START_LIVE. Consider bulk insert_many for notifications when going live.

ExternalMediaIn.publish default True auto-publishes on POST. For a 'draft first' UX (media-preview before publish) a draft toggle in the form would be safer; today every POST via UI is immediately visible to eligible members.

success_rate.backend: 97% (74/76 executed; 1 skipped by design; 2 pre-existing flakes not caused by media feature)

All deleted at end via UI + a curl sweep that also removed residual TEST_* items produced by pytest workers. MESTRE account was NOT blocked at start; no accounts left blocked.

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py: iteration-7 tests appended after line 946 (TestMediaParse + TestExternalMediaCRUDAndAccess). Stage-access test uses prevoc (stable stage=1) instead of membro (stage-3) because TestMasterChange races against membro's stage across xdist workers. If you re-introduce membro-based tests, either serialize via a pytest-ordering marker, use a dedicated stage-3 seeded account, or gate with dist=loadfile. Frontend testids: media-tab-{key}, media-search, media-card-{id}, media-manage-btn on center; media-player, media-iframe, media-fallback, media-open-external, media-open-platform-link, media-favorite-btn, media-access-error on watch; media-url, media-parse-btn, media-preview, kind-video, kind-live, media-title, media-desc, media-category, media-live-status, media-stage-{1..6}, media-submit, provider-toggle-{key}, live-status-{id}, delete-media-{id}, manage-media-{id} on manage.
rca_of_the_issue: TestLivesLifecycle flake RCA: GET /api/notifications is fixed at .to_list(50) with no since/skip. After iteration-7 tests, membro accumulates ≥50 notifications so newly-created notifications simply overwrite the tail in the returned list — n_before and n_after both cap at 50 and the strict-inequality assert fails. Fix at product level (paginate or filter) rather than at test level (would mask the API limitation). Confirmed pre-existing (not caused by media feature) — same test passed in iteration 6 with lower notification volume.
